title: Separate donor protection from wrong-bond selectivity
statement: For a shielded S/reactive A exponential race, q,k>0, all other hazards nonnegative and chi in[0,1], define DS=q+wS+hS+dS, DA=k+wA+hA+dA+e+r. Wrong/correct absorption odds are rho=(wA+e*chi)/k+(wS/q)*(DA/k), independent of hS at fixed other rates and at least(wA+e*chi)/k. With instantaneous independent harmless replenishment to the same competent S, mean time to any permanent correct/wrong/root-death outcome is (DA+q)/[(wS+dS)*DA+q*(k+wA+e*chi+dA)], also independent of hS.

requires: Fixed declared two-state exponential hazards; q,k>0, chi in[0,1], all other rates nonnegative; the specified escape outcome law.
For renewed yield/time, every H immediately and independently restores the same competent shielded parent with no delay, damage, poisoning or changed rates.
provides: For a shielded S/reactive A exponential race, q,k>0, all other hazards nonnegative and chi in[0,1], define DS=q+wS+hS+dS, DA=k+wA+hA+dA+e+r. Wrong/correct absorption odds are rho=(wA+e*chi)/k+(wS/q)*(DA/k), independent of hS at fixed other rates and at least(wA+e*chi)/k. With instantaneous independent harmless replenishment to the same competent S, mean time to any permanent correct/wrong/root-death outcome is (DA+q)/[(wS+dS)*DA+q*(k+wA+e*chi+dA)], also independent of hS.
assumptions: Wrong, harmless and destroyed-parent classes are chemically distinct. Root death is a permanent decision, not successful incorporation.
The floor compares the same active chemistry and fixed rates; DNA-mediated changes in recruitment or wrong chemistry require their own evidence.
costs: Count all donor encounters and eventual root loss. Instantaneous replacement omits real recovery, fuel, reagent and waste costs; no finite-time manufacturing guarantee follows.
contract.units: All hazards are in one inverse-time clock; t has time units, Z inverse-time squared, C,W,H,Droot,rho dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: Acquire the actual protected-state aminolysis, active wrong/correct competition, escape and rooted-parent recovery before interpreting hydrolysis protection as proofreading.

body: S switches to A at q and exits by wrong reaction wS, harmless hydrolysis hS or root destruction dS. A reshelters at r and exits by correct k, wrong wA, harmless hA, root destruction dA or escape e; escape is wrong with probability chi and harmless otherwise. Put Z=DS*DA-q*r. First-step equations give C=q*k/Z; W=[wS*DA+q*(wA+e*chi)]/Z; H=[hS*DA+q*(hA+e*(1-chi))]/Z; Droot=[dS*DA+q*dA]/Z; encounter duration t=(DA+q)/Z. These sum to one because their numerators sum to Z. Dividing W by C cancels Z. Ideal renewal gives correct-root yield C/(C+W+Droot), encounters 1/(1-H) and terminal-decision time t/(1-H); multiplying numerator and denominator by Z removes hS from yield and time. Donor consumption still changes. Increasing r at fixed other rates adds wS/(q*k) to d(rho)/dr, strictly worsening odds only if wS>0. The full governing note retains dA; the shorter response omits that hazard and cannot replace the full formula. This is a fixed-network comparison, not a claim that shielding cannot help a real molecule whose other rates change. A switch must change actual wrong-reaction competition or recruitment to improve selectivity; hydrolysis survival alone does not supply that change.

evidence.range_scope: Full two-register model including dA, absorption probabilities, ideal harmless-reset cancellation and active wrong-reaction floor.
evidence.status: Exact frozen source bytes; scientific acceptance is scoped to actual version-bound review.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed author reconstruction of the two-state first-step absorption equations, their normalization, wrong/correct odds and ideal same-parent renewal time; then damaged/delayed replacement renewal, including the restricted directional claims. Full governing note and complete response read. Acceptance covers these exact written conditional results, retaining active root loss dA. Four current code originals are unavailable; no scientific scripts, parameter sweeps, sequence-distance scans or thermodynamic checks were executed. CSV schema, 256-row count and selected endpoint rows were inspected only. Numerical claims, barcode properties and cited component experiments remain source reports; no physical operation, advantage or priority is acquired.
